svg.aria-label: A pass reads the kernel's process and socket tables, zellij's list and session files, your settings and its lists of names. It changes sessions only through zellij's own commands, and otherwise writes only its own files: its log, its lock and the lists of names. The protect and keep-name commands and the dashboard change the name lists too, and install writes the settings and the systemd units. Only recover goes around zellij: it clears a broken session's files and can stop orphan servers.
